tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: Contact details, hours, emergency policy, estimate policy, credentials and service area of Lord Mechanical LTD (plumbing, heating, gas fitting and drainage, North Vancouver, BC).

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the service pages (plumbing, heating, drainage) with their URLs and the path to pass to get_page for full details and typical prices.

tools.name: list_service_areas
tools.description: List the cities served (Metro Vancouver) and the city/neighbourhood pages, with the path to pass to get_page.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get the Markdown version of any page on lordmechanical.ca. Use a path from list_services, list_service_areas or llms.txt, e.g. "/", "/about/", "/services/plumbing/hot-water-tanks/", "/blog/hot-water-tank-cost-bc/".

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a quote / service request to Lord Mechanical LTD for a customer. Collect the details, show them to the customer, and call this only after the customer confirms. The team calls or texts the customer back. Not for emergencies: tell the customer to phone (604) 670-3737 directly.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_business_info" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_services · Private data: get_business_info · Public sink: request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_services · Private data: get_business_info · Public sink: request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
